note: Waves: 10 = cheap static checks, 20 = analysis + prose, 30 = build, 40 = checks that read dist/, test runs alone after the waves. Gaps left for later inserts.

types.note: tsconfig.json is the build config (emits dist, excludes tests); tsconfig.check.json is the no-emit gate that includes them. The adapter default `tsc --build` would emit.

lint.note: No --type-aware: oxlint-tsgolint is not installed (add it and restore the flag to opt in). oxlint.config.ts is discovered natively on Node >= 22.18, so the old `node --import tsx/esm` launcher is gone.

struct.note: Rules live in .ast-grep/rules/, wired through the root sgconfig.yml (the adapter's detect file). Both rules are severity: warning, so ast-grep exits 0 on matches; raise them to error to gate.

links.note: Names, not paths: local/generated markdown that is not the repo's docs surface (plumbbob build logs, worktree checkouts, QA snapshots, docs/superpowers). notes/ and .claude/skills/ are tracked prose and stay in the walk. The trial run was green even without excludes.

deps.description: dependency-cruiser: no circular/orphan violations in src/
deps.note: No checkride adapter for dependency-cruiser; same invocation the old lint:deps script ran.

typecheck-examples.note: Examples resolve storium from dist/ through the workspace link, so this must follow the build wave.

attw.description: Are the types wrong? (node16 + bundler resolutions)
attw.note: node16 profile ignores node10 resolution only: ./migrate has no node10-resolvable path (no typesVersions) and the top-level types field is the ESM .d.ts beside a CJS main. Engines is node >= 20 and every supported TS resolution reads `exports`. If attw is green without the profile, delete it.

smoke.note: Imports `storium` and `storium/migrate` under both import and require. migrate pulls the drizzle-orm migrators (devDeps present); drizzle-kit is only shelled out to at call time.

test.note: Adapter default: vitest run --coverage (istanbul per vitest.config.ts, writes the gitignored coverage/) plus a JSON report in .check/test.json. single: vitest saturates the cores.

integration.description: Integration suite (testcontainers: memory, postgresql, mysql; needs Docker)
integration.note: Opt-in: reach it with --all, --include integration, or --only integration (CI). Goes through the npm script because checkride has no env field and the suite needs TEST_DIALECTS. 1800s cap: image pulls on a cold runner.
